notes:
🚀Paper Lab v3.0.0 Release Notes
⚡ Tectonic Compilation Engine & Pipeline Fixes

Integrated Tectonic Compiler: Upgraded the PDF rendering backend with automatic detection and prioritization of the Tectonic typesetting engine for fast, single-pass compilation.
Resilient pdflatex Fallback: Automatic detection and fallback to local pdflatex / bibtex environments when required.
Auto Font-Map Patching (cmap.sty): Injected dynamic fallback shims for missing TeX font map definitions, eliminating fatal compilation aborts across legacy and journal templates.
🖥️ Desktop & Tauri Experience

Native External Link Interceptor: All outbound hyperlinks and documentation references now automatically open in your default OS web browser instead of navigating within the Tauri desktop container.
Dual Distribution Formats: Added both MSI (Paper Lab_3.0.0_x64_en-US.msi) and portable NSIS Setup (Paper Lab_3.0.0_x64-setup.exe) builds.
Bundled Engine Binaries: Updated desktop packaging configuration to include standalone binary sidecars and updater signatures (.sig) for seamless in-app auto-updating.
